sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Trump canceled the planned strike on Iran Saturday night: The original Truth Social post said the U.S. was "locked and loaded," but agreed to cancel the attack following requests from Iran and several Middle Eastern countries and because "the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to" (the misspelling of "parameters" became the joke of the day). The conditions were the immediate and complete reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to Iran's nuclear threat, with Israel making a parallel commitment. Saudi Crown Prince MBS spoke with Trump on Saturday to express concerns about the strike plan, while Qatar, the UAE, Turkey, and Pakistan simultaneously pressed for de-escalation. At Friday's regular-session close, SPY was at 746.79 (+0.70%) and DIA at 524.26 (+0.55%); in weekend perpetual/tokenized markets, crude oil was down approximately 5%–6.7%, while the Dow edged higher.
  • Iran immediately denied it: Fars cited a source close to the nuclear negotiating team as saying, "There is no agreement on reopening Hormuz, and the related reports are fabricated." The strait will remain restricted until the U.S. ends hostile actions, with ships permitted to use only designated lanes and requiring approval from the IRGC Navy. Israeli media reports that Araghchi had agreed to a U.S.-Qatar proposal under which Iran and Oman would separately control the strait were dismissed as fake news. Meanwhile, the Israeli military continued shelling southern Lebanon.
  • First joint Japan-U.S. FX intervention in 15 years: Reuters exclusively reported that Japan will announce joint action with the U.S. after the yen fell to its weakest level since 1986. Community members dug up a photo showing "Buy Japanese Yen (JPY)" on Bessent's cabinet meeting list as a joke, while others argued that carry-trade unwinding—not oil prices—was the real driver behind rising long-term U.S. Treasury yields.
  • The bond market is the real "constraint": The 30-year Treasury yield closed at 5.28% on 7/31, a 19-year high. Long-dated Treasuries were sold off after Warsh held rates unchanged for the seventh consecutive time, while TLT sat near a multi-year low at 82.15 (-0.78%).
  • Extreme divergence between memory stocks and mega-caps: MU 818.91 (-6.39%; opened at 918, hit a high of 930, and closed near the day's low), SNDK 1214.05 (-5.15%; opened at 1383), SOXL 112.89, AMD 476.03 (-1.87%), and OKLO 38.83 (-5.41%). On the same day, AMZN reached 271.47 (+15.15%), GOOGL 355.13 (+6.44%), META 556.60 (+3.32%), MSFT 463.20 (+2.58%), and NVDA 200.74 (+2.92%), while AAPL fell to 308.52 (-7.37%) and RDDT to 140.60 (-21.08%).
  • Coldcard hardware-wallet vulnerability continues to escalate: A March 2021 firmware release mistakenly connected seed generation to a deterministic pseudorandom number generator. Attackers have cumulatively stolen approximately $75 million in BTC, with Galaxy tracking 1,158 BTC across 2,673 addresses. MSTR closed at 93.28 (-4.42%).

社区氛围：周末异常乐观，尽管乐观情绪中夹杂着疲劳和自嘲。绝大多数人不相信这种“交易范围”代表真正的协议，但几乎每个人都认为算法无论如何都会购买关键词。主要情况是周一跳空上涨，随后盘中或本周晚些时候回调。周末看跌期权持有者集体遭到嘲笑，而相当多的人则担心 TACO 来得太早——距期货开盘还剩 30 个小时——这给了以色列和 IRGC 足够的时间来破坏它。

恐惧/贪婪等级：大约62/100，倾向于贪婪，但以“被动贪婪”的形式出现。看涨的理由不是基于基本面，而是基于“算法识别关键字”的想法。 VIX 仍保持在 16 点，多次被嘲笑为“脱离现实”，促使一些用户在一个月后买入与 VIX 相关的看涨期权。真正的恐慌集中在记忆股多头和 30 年期国债收益率上。

WSB 情绪与实际市场表现：周五的实际市场是“大型股重量级庆祝+人工智能硬件缺口和淡出”交易时段。 MU从918跌至818，SNDK从1383跌至1214，而SPY收盘上涨0.70%，仅比历史高点低约1.7%。社区对“指数很好”和“个股减半”之间的这种分歧反应强烈。一些人指出，SPX 7 月份的表现优于 QQQ 6.45%，这是自 2008 年 9 月以来的最大月度差距。其他人则引用了历史案例，其中 SPX 与高点的差距在 3% 以内，而纳斯达克指数则修正了 8% 以上，作为进一步上涨是不可避免的证据。两个阵营都在用统计数据来掩盖同一个事实：没有人知道周一会发生什么。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及情绪主要观点摘要
MU38看涨整体上被提及最多的股票。周五从 918 点暴跌至 818 点被视为“派发与黄金买入机会”之间的分界线。目标为 1000 甚至 1200 点的看涨头寸与“周一跌破 700 点”的诅咒并存。许多用户都全力投入，而一些用户则用保证金接住周五晚间落下的刀子。用户一再提醒其他人，财报是在9月份，而不是本周，这意味着短期交易完全取决于TACO和DRAM现货价格。 “周一+10%，周二-15%”是最典型的预期路径。
